items.source: Primarily intended for use within the framework.
Get the value of the named property.
name - the name of the property to retrieve
the value of the property or null if not found
items.translation: 该属性的值，如果未找到则为null。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
